name: Alexandria Bay Farmers Market
tagline: Alexandria Bay Farmers' Market at Swan Bay
description: Alexandria Bay Farmers Market is a farmers market in Route 12, NY, bringing together local growers, bakers, and makers. Shoppers can find seasonal produce, baked goods, and artisan products from area farms. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
